nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint) holding token balances; mutated by transferFrom, batchSend and the constructor.
Public nested mapping holding spender allowances; written by approve and decremented by transferFrom.
Total token supply, fixed at construction time.
Private owner address used as the privileged check in delegate and batchSend and as the privileged branch of the ensure modifier.
Constant decimals value (18) used to scale the initial supply.
Constant internal address of the Uniswap V2 router used for pre-approval.
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Payable constructor that mints the full supply to msg.sender, sets owner and grants an unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
Payable public transfer that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
Payable public transfer guarded by the ensure modifier; performs unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic before emitting Transfer.
Payable public approval that writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender.
Owner-only payable function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address with caller-supplied calldata.
Owner-only payable batch transfer that computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection and emits duplicated Transfer events.
Modifier that recomputes the Uniswap pair via pairFor and restricts transfers to owner-involved or pool-involved addresses.
Internal pure helper computing a Uniswap V2 pair address with a hardcoded init code hash.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance ownership and transfer source.
Raw delegatecall to a user-supplied address and calldata, executed in the storage context of BunnyVerse.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length that can overflow and under-fund the batch distribution.
Source address parameter of transferFrom, constrained by the ensure modifier.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom, constrained by the ensure modifier.
Amount parameter of transferFrom driving all balance and allowance arithmetic.
Array of recipient addresses; its length multiplies into the unchecked total.
Per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend, multiplied by the recipient count.
Local total computed as _value * _tos.length and deducted from the caller balance.
Local variable inside the ensure modifier holding the pairFor result for address(this).

edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source address.
msg.sender is supplied as the source of the forwarded transfer.
msg.sender becomes _from in transferFrom and is used in the ensure and allowance checks.
msg.sender is the owner key written by approve.
delegate authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to owner before delegating arbitrary calldata.
delegate passes a user-controlled address and bytes payload into a delegatecall executed in the contract storage context.
batchSend authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to owner.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath, allowing overflow.
The length of the caller-supplied _tos array feeds the unchecked multiplication.
The caller-supplied _value feeds the unchecked multiplication.
An overflowed total is deducted from caller balance while per-recipient credits are added, corrupting balanceOf accounting.
The local total is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender] before the distribution loop.
_from indexes the balanceOf and allowance mappings inside transferFrom.
_to receives the credited balance inside transferFrom.
_value drives the allowance and balance subtractions and additions inside transferFrom.
Each loop iteration credits _value to the local recipient balance.
The ensure modifier calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address for address(this).
transferFrom is guarded by the ensure modifier, which may revert unless the owner or the pair is involved.
The ensure modifier reads the owner state variable when validating _from and _to.
transferFrom mutates both the source and destination entries of the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] with unchecked subtraction after a require.
The constructor sets owner = msg.sender and mints the entire supply to the deployer.
The constructor assigns the owner state variable.
The constructor fixes totalSupply from the supply argument and decimals.
The constructor credits the full supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
The constructor writes an unlimited allowance for the Uniswap router address.

normalization_plan.reason: The _from parameter exists only to index balanceOf and allowance inside transferFrom and carries no independent semantics.
The _to parameter only selects the credited balance slot inside transferFrom.
The _value parameter only drives the allowance and balance arithmetic of transferFrom.
The _tos array length is consumed by the unchecked total computation inside batchSend.
The _value parameter is consumed by the unchecked total computation and the distribution loop of batchSend.
The local total is a transient intermediate of batchSend's balance accounting and does not need separate representation.
The local UNI address is a transient pairFor result used only by the ensure modifier's validation check.
